hints: Foam cups, foam takeout containers and foam meat trays are polystyrene_foam, not plastic_container.
Plastic shopping bags, bread bags, bubble wrap and plastic film or overwrap are plastic_bag_film.
Chip bags, candy wrappers and snack wrappers are chip_bag, not plastic_bag_film or plastic_container.
Trading cards, playing cards, photos, toys and clothing are not boxboard, paper or any other listed category: answer unknown and name the item, so Sortify can look it up.
